entities.name: Mezlok
entities.description: Proud young human planeswalker and wizard, great-grandson of Minoch.

entities.name: Jehadt
entities.description: Warder of Gordahn who challenged Mezlok to a duel and lost.

entities.name: Gordahn
entities.description: Village whose chief chose Mezlok as duelist.

entities.name: Mirrankkar
entities.description: Plane hosting the contest of mages.

entities.name: Obsidias
entities.description: Plane where Mezlok had a run-in with a rival.

events.summary: Jehadt challenges Mezlok to a duel, loses and teleports away.
events.quote: Jehadt was offended by this and challenged Mezlok to a duel. He lost and teleported away, hoping to face Mezlok again someday.

events.summary: Mezlok, chosen by Gordahn, is the final entry in the contest.
